official_pricing.notes: Approximate curated public list derived from published tariff schedules. Not a live calculator quote. Prefer merchant e-commerce API or official نرخنامه PDF for transactional pricing.

service_coverage.notes: National retail network — official claimed footprint, not Maps-observed count.

insurance_rules.notes: Registered / insured postal products; coverage depends on selected service.

tracking.notes: Only publicly available tracking surfaces are referenced — no private APIs.

working_hours.notes: Government office calendar; local post-office variance is common.
